title: Add Batch Operations for Emails
body:
## Description
This PR adds two new powerful features to the Gmail MCP Server:

1. **Batch Modify Emails** (`batch_modify_emails`): Allows modifying labels for multiple emails in efficient batches
2. **Batch Delete Emails** (`batch_delete_emails`): Enables deleting multiple emails in efficient batches

These features enable much more efficient inbox management by processing up to 50 emails at once (configurable batch size), helping users clean up their inbox, organize emails, and perform bulk operations quickly.

## Implementation Details
- Added two new schema definitions for batch operations
- Implemented a flexible `processBatches` helper function that handles batching and error recovery
- Added robust error handling with individual retry logic for failed batch items
- Updated the README.md to document the new features
- Complete backward compatibility with existing functionality

## Benefits
- Significantly faster processing of multiple emails
- Automatic chunking of large sets to stay within API limits
- Detailed success/failure reporting for each operation
- Graceful error handling with individual retries on batch failures

This contribution addresses a common need for bulk email operations and makes the Gmail MCP Server much more powerful for inbox organization tasks.
